title: Echoed key field differs, so the pair fails (near-miss)
notes: The MAC-processed file echoes the submitted total charge 192.00 with all three lines (the third denied CO*204); the vendor-processed file reports only the two adjudicated lines and CLP03 132.00. Total charge is a key field, so the MAC claim is missing and the vendor claim is extra although patient, date, and payee agree. Follows the rule-gap cause (echoing the adjudicated total); the entry's CLP01 truncation example is not a key field under the matching key and would pair.
